QuestInfo.name: Fact Versus Truth
QuestInfo.0: All this chaos with the Unidentified Assailants is messing with your head. What next?
QuestInfo.1: You can't unravel this mystery out on your own. Return to Ereve and talk to Neinheart. #bTip: Use Imperial Recall to go straight to Ereve.#k
QuestInfo.2: Pondering what the Unidentified Assailant said is messing with your head, so you asked Neinheart for advice. He told you that fact and truth aren't always the same. Now you're more confused than ever...
QuestInfo.parent: Where in Maple World is Chromile the Knight?

0.0: I feel like I'm sinking. I need to get back to Ereve, back to Neinheart. I need answers.

no.0: No... Will speaking with him really help? I feel more in the dark than ever...

0.1: You can return to Ereve by #bpressing the Hotkey #e[K]#n#k and using the skill #bImperial Recall#k. Try it now.

1.0: You look like a drowned rat. Slightly better than I expected, to be honest... \r\n#L0##bWas my father... was Chromile a good person? Was he worth all of this?#l\n#k
1.1: I see the trail through your father's past is as full of brambles as I had assumed. The truth, my young friend, is that I do not know and you may never truly know. However, I will tell you one thing... \nWhen you find yourself confronted with a truth that seems to bring you to your knees, open your eyes and look for the whole of the story. It is easy delude yourself with facts, believing you see the whole picture, but it is a conceit. There is always more to a story. Whether it be good or bad, it can at least be whole, and in that you can find peace.
